newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-KLUIVERT FACES KNEE SURGERY, WILL MISS CUP SEMI-FINAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KLUIVERT FACES KNEE SURGERY, WILL MISS CUP SEMI-FINAL.

text.p: Ajax Amsterdam striker Patrick Kluivert may have played his last game for the Dutch champions.

Kluivert, 20, will undergo surgery on a troublesome cartilage injury in his right knee on Wednesday, just hours before his side is due to play Juventus in the first leg of their European Cup semi-final, Dutch media reported on Saturday.
The player, who will join AC Milan at the end of this season, will need at least six weeks to recover from the operation to be performed at an Amsterdam hospital, doctors were quoted as saying.
Kluivert had said that he wanted to play in the Juventus game but was under doctors' orders to have the operation.
"That (playing) was just not very sensible," Ajax doctor Piet van Bon was quoted as saying.
Kluivert was injured during the Netherlands 1-0 defeat by Turkey in a World Cup qualifier last Wednesday.
